## Research Profile

Biomedical Engineering PhD student specializing in EEG-based cognitive neuroscience and Fast Periodic Visual Stimulation (FPVS). My research focuses on standardizing FPVS experiment design and data analysis through accessible, reproducible software, with longer-term applications in mild cognitive impairment related to dementia.

## Education

### Doctor of Philosophy in Biomedical Engineering

**Mississippi State University** | Starkville, Mississippi | 2026-Present<br>
Research focus: Development of software for the administration and data analysis of FPVS experiments.

### Master of Science in Biomedical Engineering

**Mississippi State University** | Starkville, Mississippi | 2024-2026<br>
Research project: Investigating semantic categorization with semantically similar stimuli using Fast Periodic Visual Stimulation.

## Research Software

### FPVS Studio 2.0

**Creator and developer** | Python 3.10, PySide6 | 2026<br>
Standalone application for designing and running FPVS experiments, including condition and stimulus management and BioSemi system support.<br>
[GitHub](https://github.com/zcm58/FPVS-Studio-2.0){target="_blank"} | [Zenodo DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20343059){target="_blank"}

### FPVS Toolbox

**Creator and developer** | Python | 2026<br>
Package for FPVS data processing, analysis, and figure creation. It supports BioSemi `.bdf` files and produces outputs for downstream analysis in JASP, R, and SAS.<br>
[GitHub](https://github.com/zcm58/FPVS-Toolbox-Repo){target="_blank"} | [Zenodo DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20342767){target="_blank"}

## Technical Expertise

**Programming and software development:** Python, R, MATLAB, PySide6, graphical user interface development, parallel processing, reproducible analysis workflows, and Git/GitHub.

**EEG and cognitive neuroscience:** FPVS paradigm design; EEG data acquisition, analysis, and visualization; BioSemi ActiveTwo setup and troubleshooting across hundreds of participant sessions.
